status: recorded before the first E28L measurement
scope: Linux latency and lite runner comparison budgets only; capacity runners and Darwin counters are unchanged
counter: POSIX clock_getcpuclockid followed by clock_gettime_ns, aggregate running CPU of all process threads including exited threads
reason: Full /proc usage reports enumerate every thread. Repeating them for every limiter budget sample risks saturating D12's harness CPU. The budget needs aggregate process CPU only.
proof: The native counter includes a completed worker thread's CPU and agrees with the process stat counter within its clock-tick precision. The budget run and signal methods are inherited by identity, not copied or rewritten.
observation: No limiter saturation measurement was run or discarded to motivate this port; this is source inspection and a native counter unit test.
